orderingRule: MigrationScriptLoader orders SQL files by file name; schema_migrations records the full file stem as migration_id.

allowedDuplicateOrdinals.reason: Both migrations are already applied by full migration_id in local/runtime ledgers; renumbering would break traceability.

allowedMissingOrdinals.reason: Reserved gap caused by the historical 034 duplicate; do not backfill with a renamed applied migration.

futureRule: New migrations must use the next unused three-digit ordinal and unique snake_case file stem.
